_comment: Model distribution manifest (D2). SHA256 and sizeBytes are REAL — measured from
the local model files — and are the download gate: any fetched file whose SHA256
does not match is rejected, whatever the URL. Each source.url was VERIFIED on
2026-07-12 by comparing our local SHA256 against the repo's git-LFS pointer oid
(exact match), so source.confirmed=true. URLs resolve the 'main' branch; the
SHA256 gate still protects against any future re-upload. Licenses are the upstream
model licenses; re-confirm against each repo's LICENSE when vendoring.
